_about: Configuration for galaxy_pipeline.py. Everything here is OPTIONAL: with an empty file the pipeline still discovers and processes every FITS image under data_dir. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
_exclude: Glob patterns matched against file name, FITS TARGNAME or field name. M16 (NGC 6611, Pillars of Creation) is a Milky-Way star-forming nebula, not a galaxy field -- dropped from the morphology pipeline in earlier stage.
_field_aliases: Cosmetic display names for fields, matched on TARGNAME / file name. Fields with no alias are named after a catalogue group whose members fall inside them, else after their most common TARGNAME.
_defaults: Overrides of galaxy_pipeline.DEFAULTS for every image. neighbour-model run: neighbour_model (subtract smooth models of other objects before measuring) is OFF -- on 73 labelled galaxies it lowered LOGO-CV accuracy from 69.9% to 64.4% (Output/neighbour_model_output/neighbour_model_evaluation.md). Set it true together with measure_legacy to reproduce that comparison. final configuration: max_clipped_frac 0.15 -- a galaxy whose 1.5 r_p aperture is more than 15 % cut off by the frame or a chip gap is flagged unmeasurable (label-free truncation simulation, preregistration.md amendment A1).
_instrument_overrides: Applied to every image taken with this INSTRUME (or INSTRUME/DETECTOR). Values for WFPC2 are the ones that were tuned on the HCG 16 WFPC2/PC mosaic in earlier stage (older, noisier chips, diffraction-spike/bleed-inflated stars, mosaic footprint); keyed by instrument so every WFPC2 frame (HCG 16, 79, 87, ...) gets them, not one named target.
_field_overrides: Per-field overrides (glob on field name). Use only when a field genuinely needs it.
